text: This story owns AC2 of RWB-E4-046 word for word, and AC1 is left to RWB-ITG-E4046-ITG, which is the story that copies it. The booking is tested on a synthetic set taken from the values AC1 names: treatment T-0001 accepted at a settlement amount of 820000 for account A-0001, on case RC-2026-000431 for business date 2027-02-26. The booking detail behind the generic legacy lines is filled from FSD P8 A2.6 and TSD P8, and the four legacy test case IDs keep their own rows in the Test Cases master.
why: AC2 is generic and its four legacy test cases name no case, treatment, account, amount, interface or business date, so the story cannot be built or tested without a stated data set, and the ownership of AC1 has to be decided before two stories prove it twice.
read: Legacy RWB-E4-046 (Story, Acceptance criteria, Data, Test cases); FSD P8 v3 A2.6.4.1; work package line for RWB-P8-E4046-APP; RWB-ITG-E4046-ITG sections 7 and 19
confirm: P8 business analyst and the Settlement route set owner at the E4 test data review
impact: The test data and the traceability row only; AC2, its wording and the four test case IDs are unchanged

text: The booking step is rwb-payment's: SettlementBookingWorkflow on queue rwb-payment, event-started by rwb.treatment.TreatmentApproved.v1, running postBooking (read the terms, evaluate the route set, write the record, call deliverFile) and readBackBooking (read the data product after AceDataReady, compare, write the confirmation and the outbox row). The outbound request is the deliverFile(manifest) activity of rwb-integration. The manifest element set, the payload of rwb.payment.TreatmentBooked.v1, the data product code, the ALS interface values and the wait timer are not published and carry the placeholder until their owners publish them.
why: No source names the two activities, fixes the manifest or the event payload, or gives the ALS interface values and the product code, and the story cannot be built or asserted without a stated reading.
read: Legacy RWB-E4-046; FSD P8 v3 A2.6.2 and A2.6.4; TSD P8 v2 T5.1 and T5.3; Architecture v5 slides 42 and 43 (EV-11); RWB-P2-E4046-APP sections 3 and 12.5
confirm: P8 solution architect, the P2 integration owner and the event catalogue owner at the contract review
impact: The package, the trigger, the event payload and the manifest only; AC2, the messages and the 2 s budget are unchanged

text: rwb-payment holds no grant on the recovery.v_ace_* views and no grant on another rwb_* schema, so the booked position and the settlement payment are read on the rwb-source-data data product with its freshness stamp; the legacy v_ace_account and v_ace_payment reads are retired, and VR-P8-006-1 with MSG-P1-001 is kept exactly as the FSD states it.
why: The legacy story reads two ACE views in process while the target gives SELECT on the views to rwb-source-data alone, and the story cannot be built against a grant it will not have.
read: Legacy RWB-E4-046 (Data); FSD P8 v3 change note and A2.6.3.1; context pack P8; Template and Rules R5.5 DP-05
confirm: P1 source-data owner and the P8 solution architect at the contract review
impact: One read path and one grant only; the stale-data rule, its message and every criterion are unchanged

text: The metadata row 'Contract dependencies' stays None as the work package gives it, and the four consumed REST reads and the consumed deliverFile activity contract are treated as class C dependencies built against their published documents and fakes from Day 1: the rwb-treatment terms read, the rwb-source-data product read, the rwb-integration item read and the rwb-case case read.
why: The work package gives C as empty while the step consumes five answers, and R5.4 makes a class C row non-blocking, so the two statements have to be read together rather than one corrected silently.
read: Work package line for RWB-P8-E4046-APP; Template and Rules R5.4 and R5.7; sections 12.2 and 12.5 of the story
confirm: P8 solution architect and the split-plan owner at the next plan version
impact: The dependency display only; Day 1, the lane, the H rows and every criterion are unchanged

text: outbound_item stays with P2 rwb-integration in rwb_integration, and rwb_payment holds no booking row: the item is tracked by its reference on P2's contract, the confirmation is the local decision record, and the booking reference travels on TreatmentBooked for the case to record. proceeds is the one table of this service and this step does not write it.
why: The legacy story tracks the booking in outbound_item, which the Ownership Map gives to rwb-integration, so the target has to name where the booking reference lives instead.
read: Legacy RWB-E4-046 (Story, Data); context pack P8 ownership rows; RWB-P2-E4046-APP section 12.7; Template and Rules R5.5 DP-01
confirm: P8 solution architect and the P2 integration owner at the LDM review
impact: The table list and the tracking path only; the criterion, the event and the messages are unchanged

text: The booking of a settlement is raised by rwb-payment after TreatmentApproved, and a booking rejected by ALS follows the exception queue and the owner task of P2's outbound_item while the case stays with operations, because the settlement route set has no rejection row of its own and R-RES-23 belongs to the restructure route.
why: Two sources allow the call from either service, and the settlement route set has no booking-rejection row, so a stated reading is needed for the flow, the states and the exception table.
read: Legacy RWB-E4-046 AC1; FSD P8 v3 A2.6.2 and A2.6.3.3; RWB-P2-E4046-APP section 12.5; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 (R-SET-10, R-SET-13, R-RES-22, R-RES-23)
confirm: Settlement route set owner and the P3 case owner at the routing-logic review

text: The story is issued in status Draft (realignment v1), the release date 28 February 2027 is copied unchanged and marked tentative, and the PRD reference stays Pending (C1), because no human approval gate was met in this run and none is required under D-RCV-60.
why: The realignment run proceeds without human approval and no approved BRD, PRD or status is available to cite, so the default status has to be stated rather than left empty.
